'''Wei-Ming Ni''' ({{zh|t=倪維明(倪维明)}}; born 23 December 1950)<ref name="1&quot;">{{Cite web |title=NI, Wei-Ming|url=https://sse.cuhk.edu.cn/en/faculty/niweiming|access-date=5 September 2023 |website=sse.cuhk.edu.cn}}</ref> is a Taiwanese mathematician. He is a Presidential Chair Professor at the [[Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen]] and a professor emeritus at the [[University of Minnesota]]. He was previously the director of the Center for PDE at the [[East China Normal University]].

== Education and career ==
Ni works in the field of elliptic and parabolic [[partial differential equations]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wei-Ming Ni's Home Page |url=http://www-users.math.umn.edu/~wmni/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811152608/http://www-users.math.umn.edu/~wmni/ |archive-date=11 August 2020 |access-date=22 October 2020 |website=[[University of Minnesota]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Welcome to Center for PDE |url=http://cpde.ecnu.edu.cn/peopledetail.php?id=3 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200714002522/http://cpde.ecnu.edu.cn/peopledetail.php?id=3 |archive-date=14 July 2020 |access-date=22 October 2020 |website=cpde.ecnu.edu.cn}}</ref> He graduated from [[National Taiwan University]] with a [[B.S.]] in mathematics in 1972 and earned his [[Ph.D.]] in mathematics from [[New York University]] in 1979 under [[Louis Nirenberg]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wei-Ming Ni - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=11637 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200707230455/https://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=11637 |archive-date=7 July 2020 |access-date=11 July 2020 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project |publisher=Department of Mathematics - North Dakota State University}}</ref>

Ni is an editor-in-chief of the ''Journal of Differential Equations'', and was an [[Institute for Scientific Information|ISI Highly Cited Researcher]] in 2002.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal of Differential Equations Editorial Board |url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-differential-equations/editorial-board |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200819071433/https://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-differential-equations/editorial-board |archive-date=19 August 2020 |access-date=22 October 2020 |via=www.journals.elsevier.com}}</ref><ref name="dcds">Chen, Chiun-Chuan; Lou, Yuan; Ninomiya, Hirokazu; Polacik, Peter; Wang, Xuefeng. ''Preface: DCDS-a special issue to honor Wei-Ming Ni’s 70th birthday.'' Discrete Contin. Dyn. Syst. 40 (2020), no. 6, i-ii.</ref> As said by the journal ''Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems'':
{{quote|[Ni] first became a household name in the PDE community when he published with Gidas and Nirenberg the seminal paper in 1979, “On the symmetry of positive solutions of nonlinear elliptic equations” [...] The research and expository work of Professor Ni has influenced the research directions and activities of a large number of mathematicians, many of whom are playing important roles in the field of partial differential equations today.<ref name="dcds" />}}

== Major publications ==
* Gidas, B.; Ni, Wei Ming; Nirenberg, L. ''[http://web.math.unifi.it/users/magnanin/Dott/BibliografiaCorso/GidasNiNirenberg79.pdf Symmetry and related properties via the maximum principle].'' Comm. Math. Phys. 68 (1979), no. 3, 209–243.
* Gidas, B.; Ni, Wei Ming; Nirenberg, L. ''Symmetry of positive solutions of nonlinear elliptic equations in {{math|ℝ<sup>n</sup>}}.'' Mathematical analysis and applications, Part A, pp. 369–402, Adv. in Math. Suppl. Stud., 7a, Academic Press, New York-London, 1981.
* Lin, C.-S.; Ni, W.-M.; Takagi, I. ''[https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0022039688901477/pdf?md5=7ab23c71b7fb3cd505f1394b0035db10&pid=1-s2.0-0022039688901477-main.pdf Large amplitude stationary solutions to a chemotaxis system].'' J. Differential Equations 72 (1988), no. 1, 1–27.
* Ni, Wei-Ming; Takagi, Izumi. ''On the shape of least-energy solutions to a semilinear Neumann problem.'' Comm. Pure Appl. Math. 44 (1991), no. 7, 819–851.
* Lou, Yuan; Ni, Wei-Ming. ''[https://core.ac.uk/download/pdf/82189397.pdf Diffusion, self-diffusion and cross-diffusion].'' J. Differential Equations 131 (1996), no. 1, 79–131.
* Ni, Wei-Ming. ''[https://web.archive.org/web/20200712212659/https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/840f/51c06867697131d16b2f57f519532a9e1987.pdf Diffusion, cross-diffusion, and their spike-layer steady states].'' Notices Amer. Math. Soc. 45 (1998), no. 1, 9–18.
